in_hebrew.name: Derby
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו From Derw's town
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derby הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English 'deorbe' or 'thorpe', meaning 'a place of an animal'. The name was later adopted from the Old French 'derbe', meaning 'dear, beloved'. In Greek mythology, Derbes was a son of the god Poseidon and the nymph Peribea, and was said to have been the founder of the ancient Greek city of Derbe.

in_latin.name: Derby
in_latin.meaning: Origin of English surname; possibly derived from Old English
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen auctoris Anglici, potenter a lingua Anglica antiqua derivatum, possibilter a vocabulo antiquo 'Deerby' vel 'Derby', quod in locum in comitatu Derbyensi in Anglia situm est, unde incolae etiam 'Derbyenses' nominabantur. Nomen hunc in ecclesiis Christianis saeculi XVII in Anglia usitatum est, ut in catalogo nominum sacerdotum Cathedralis Ecclesiae Derbyensi in comitatu Derbyensi in Anglia anno 1644, ubi nomen 'Derby' inventum est. Nomen haec in ecclesiis Anglicanis et in ecclesiis Catholicis Romanae in Anglia usitatum est.
